title: PakEmis-GHG: a reproducible ten-module national greenhouse-gas inventory for Pakistan, excluding LULUCF

creators.name: Ahmad, Rehan
creators.affiliation: Pakistan Air Quality Initiative (PAQI), Karachi, Pakistan

description:
A reproducible national emissions inventory for Pakistan covering ten sectors, with national, provincial, district and gridded products.

Sector modules satisfy a common software contract; cross-sector fuel and material transfers close by construction; structural choices are reported as named scenarios rather than folded into parametric uncertainty; and every figure and table in the accompanying manuscripts is generated from the calculation engine. The release carries a machine-readable manifest recording the version, the baseline configuration, each sector's reference year, the completeness counts and the hash of every primary source.

The baseline configuration is L (ledger-closed residential dung). The survey-demand configuration S is published as a co-equal second national result, not as a sensitivity. LULUCF is excluded from all totals and carried as an exploratory module.

Code is MIT licensed; data products, figures and manuscript text are CC-BY-4.0. Geometry tables extracted from OpenStreetMap are derivative databases under ODbL 1.0 and carry share-alike; LICENSE-data lists them.

What this deposit does not contain. The third-party source documents the inventory was read from — OGRA, NEPRA, PBS, NFDC and PCAA publications, and PBS HIES microdata — are not included. Their redistribution terms are, for most of them, not established, and this project cannot license what it does not own. What ships instead is a source document register naming every publication, recording its SHA-256, and stating where to obtain it from its publisher, so a reader can confirm they hold the same document this release read. Reproducing the build end to end therefore requires re-acquiring those publications; everything else needed is here.
